The '''case file 127456''' was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] official record by the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It recorded information about the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Sifo-Dyas/Legends|Sifo-Dyas]] and provided official information regarding the suspicious circumstances of his [[Death/Legends|death]].
